title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(土屋利明研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Tsuchiya Toshiaki)
educationalGoal: This course is a design project for jet engines and gas turbines. Students will gain the ability to study and apply their knowledge in the field of jet engines and gas turbines.
advice: Students will study as follows. 1.High temperature/high efficiency engines 2.Reduction of noise and pollutants from jet engines 3.High performance of engines 4.Reliability enhancement of the emergency generator 5.History of engine development. 6.Comparison of gas turbine engines with other internal combustion engines.

activityGoals.body: Be able to conduct activities according to the mechanical design method.
Be able to present and discuss study results in a public technical conference.
Be able to design,draw,manufacture and test against the theme of project.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1.Be able to classify the project theme. 2.Be able to understand the knowledge and capabilities necessary to conduct the project. 3.Be able to plan the project schedule and follow through. 4.Be able to collect the relevant information. 5.Be able to plan tasks,propose,a counterplan and conduct the counterplan. 6.Be able to generalize the results and be versatile. 7.Be able to present the results effectively.
achievementLevels.standard: 1.Be able to explain the project theme. 2.Be able to brush up on knowledge and skills. 3.Be able to control the schedule in the short term. 4.Be able to collect relevant information according to guidance by the teacher. 5.Be able to explain the research results of the project tasks and counterproposals. 6.Be able to understand the research results ,and explain them to other persons. 7.Be able to present and discuss the research results.

lessons.operation: ・Survey on research theme ・Conduct research ・Seminar ・Interim presentation ・Final presentation ・Submit reports
lessons.assignments: Survey of open literatures, previous project report, Master thesis report
